# About organisation and Postcards discovery — 24 October 2026

## Scope

Owner requested a clearer division of About information among appropriate existing pages and easier access to Postcards. Staging only; no email, production, database, Auth, billing, provider or delivery activation change.

## Editorial distribution

- About now opens with the personal origin, home base and education. Personality and travel preferences are consolidated into three closed native disclosures. Real supplied details (local respect, assistant-manager experience, hostels, daily rhythm, animals/outdoors, fitness and the Spanish mantra) remain.
- Full equipment details are extracted unchanged to creator-kit.html, used by /my-kit. About offers a short kit card rather than duplicating the whole page. Homepage /my-kit links navigate to that ordinary document; legacy /#kit and view=kit resolve there. Existing gear editor group identities are preserved.
- The complete visited-place list already exists in Atlas; About now links to it instead of repeating the list. Existing real Thailand wildlife and Philippines El Nido chapters receive contextual links. Sak Yant detail/video remains in the film collection, with a clear direct entry from About. Professional contact remains on Contact & collaborate.
- Postcards is a primary shared-header link on desktop and in the mobile menu. About also has distinct archive and signup actions, alongside the existing journey status link. Existing homepage signup/archive links remain. No form or subscription was submitted.
- About support remains available behind a closed disclosure. Its original support fragment, date-based launch, pending copy and payment link are unchanged; a direct /about#support opens it. No new background video on About.
- Updated shared/generated documents, search and owner-editor catalogue. About group fingerprints change with the structure and retire safely rather than applying an old override to a new field. Private drafts/history/backups were not read, migrated or deleted. About currently has new editable groups; existing saved history remains separate.
